title: GraveGain1D
description: A one-dimensional GraveGain RPG: walk the ley-line east, always right, never jump. Turn-based tactics or real-time action on the same rules core, 5 sectors, bosses, codex lore, and endless Echo Drift.

maker.name: 4weird Games
maker.bio: One dimension is all a courier needs: walk east, hold the line, deliver the charge.

keyboard.Right Arrow / D: Step east (turn-based: 1 tick; real-time: move intent)

touch.bottom bar: STEP, ATK, ABILITY, POTION, WAIT buttons

instructions: Pick turn-based or real-time, pick a class, and walk east along the ley-line toward Hades' spire. Clear 5 sectors and their bosses, then push into endless Echo Drift. You can never move left and never jump — the line only goes right.
